title: Lazurio Marketplace offer, version 1
description: One module template listed in the Marketplace of Lazurio: the public repository it is released from, the words and screens of its card, and its releases. A listing is discovery information, never permission.

id.description: The offer's id, unique in the registry; Lazurio shows it at /marketplace/<id>. At most 32 characters, so that Lazurio's adoption prompt id marketplace-<id>-<seed>-<release> stays within the 64 characters of a prompt Chat takes by link.

section.description: The Marketplace section; app templates only in version 1.

module.description: The module slug an adoption proposes; equal to the id in the template's lazurio.module.json. The agent confirms it against the Organization's own modules.

repository.description: The public GitHub repository the releases come from, owner/name.

publisher.description: The GitHub Organization or account that publishes the releases; the owner of repository and the directory of this file.

movedFrom.description: The repository earlier records named, when the template moved to repository with a clean history. Informative only.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the template's license, as GitHub detects it in the release.

stone.description: The stone the adopted module shows in Apps; Lazurio shows its default stone for a key it does not know.

pricing.description: Reserved for paid templates; free is the only value in version 1.

summary.description: The one line of the card and the detail.

features.description: What the app does: a short title and its sentence each.

seeds.description: How an adopted module may start: empty always, sample when the release carries an invented example. The label is the dialog's choice; the brief completes the person's own words to the agent "Start with …" (in Czech the informal ty).

screenshots.description: Screens of the app at the offered release: WebP files 1600 px wide in its repository, with invented content only. The first one is the card's. Without a language at most 6 screens. A screen may name its language (locale): then every screen names one, Czech and English have the same number of screens, at most 6 each, and Lazurio shows those in the page's language (the registry's rules, src/registry.ts). Lazurio releases before the one that reads locale refuse an index with it, so a record with locale waits for that release.

locale.description: The language of the words on the screen; Lazurio shows the screens in the page's language, else those without one, else any.

releases.description: The releases, newest first. Lazurio shows an offer only once a release has its commit recorded, and offers the newest such release; an offer whose releases all lack one is announced here, not shown.

version.description: Semantic version of the release, independent of the app generation.

tag.description: The annotated tag of the release, v<version>.

generation.description: The app generation of this release, app/v<N>; it names the data layer, not quality. A generation transition is a release.

stackProfile.description: The stack profile and its release this release is built on, <profile>@<YYYY.MM> or a security patch <profile>@<YYYY.MM.P> (LazurioPlatform docs/stack-profiles.md). The profile belongs to the generation: app to app/v1 and app/v2, content to app/v1 and app/v2 (app/v3 with data), app-data to app/v3, app-database to app/v4.

stack.description: The stack the scaffold creates for this release (lazurio module create --stack).

bun.description: The exact Bun this release pins (packageManager bun@x.y.z); a release of the stack profile changes it.

commit.description: The full commit the tag points to; null until the release is published. A tag alone is not an immutable identity.

artifactDigest.description: Digest of the release's attested artifact; null until there is one.

label.description: A short title in Czech and English.

line.description: One line in Czech and English.

paragraph.description: A sentence or two in Czech and English.
